tips_en: Start with WorldLeague: it poses the most consequential question in this set—whether visual-language understanding actually converts into autonomous physical action—and the finding that 71.8% of VLM episodes had perfect terminal QA yet zero physical progress makes that gap concrete, while the shared harness is reusable for other embodied work. PartAgent is the natural companion read, since its VLM-in-the-loop inspection, composition, and verification of 3D partitions supplies exactly the kind of grounded 3D perception module embodied policies (including WorldLeague's VLAs and world-action models) tend to lack. LoomFormer sits at the model level, offering per-token, head-level dynamic rewiring as a mechanism for the context-dependent routing an agentic or embodied policy needs, and is the paper to pick first if your interest is architecture and mechanistic interpretability rather than benchmarks.
tips_zh: 建议先读 WorldLeague：它提出了这组论文中最具冲击力的核心问题——视觉语言理解能否真正转化为自主的物理行动，而「71.8% 的 VLM 回合问答满分却零物理进展」这一结果直观暴露了能力落差，其统一评测框架也便于其他具身工作复用。与之搭配读 PartAgent：其 VLM 在环的检查、组合、修复与验证机制，正是具身策略（包括 WorldLeague 中的 VLA 与世界动作模型）所欠缺的 3D 场景感知落地能力。LoomFormer 则处在模型层面，按 token 的注意力头部动态重路由为智能体/具身策略所需的情境依赖路由提供了机制思路；若你更关注架构与可解释性而非基准评测，可优先读它。
